name: ctg-disponibilidade-mobile
description: App mobile nativo (Android e iOS) do painel de Disponibilidade e FID da CTG Brasil

scripts.prepare:web: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '..'); from scripts.app.mobile import exportar_bundle_mobile; print(exportar_bundle_mobile('..'))"
scripts.sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync
scripts.sync:android: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync ios
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
